preconditions.description: Input integers u and v are non-negative and bounded by 10^18.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and stdout.splitlines()[0].isdigit() and all(line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or a valid array description: first line is the array length n (non-negative integer), followed by n positive integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (lambda: (lambda arr: (int(arr[0]) == len(arr[1:]) and sum(map(int, arr[1:])) == int(v) and (lambda xor: (xor := 0, [xor ^= int(x) for x in arr[1:]], xor == int(u))[2]))(stdout.splitlines()))())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the array satisfies the conditions: its sum equals v and its bitwise-xor equals u.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (lambda: (lambda arr: (lambda n: n == 0 or (n == len(arr[1:]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in arr[1:])))(int(arr[0])))(stdout.splitlines()))())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the array length n is non-negative, and all elements are positive integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (lambda: (lambda arr: (lambda n: n == 0 or (n == len(arr[1:]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in arr[1:])))(int(arr[0])) and (lambda xor: (xor := 0, [xor ^= int(x) for x in arr[1:]], xor == int(u))[2]) and sum(map(int, arr[1:])) == int(v))(stdout.splitlines()))())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the array is minimal in length (no shorter array exists satisfying the conditions).
